description: Spagnolo — Colore: White & gold Collezione: Imago Codice: 5829 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Classic Scala: Medium Altezza: 140 cm Rapporto: 35 cm × 42.5 cm Toni: White SPAGNOLO is one of Mariano Fortuny's earliest designs, a 17th-century Spanish pattern created at the beginning of his career as a tribute to his motherland . The motif that winds through SPAGNOLO, lush, mid-bloom, framed by tangled vines and leafy tendrils, is both personal and universal, a symbol carried across Spanish, Moorish, and Italian decorative traditions. The design moves across the field like an intricately wrought gate: structured in its overall geometry, effusive in its individual forms. SPAGNOLO's jewel-toned colorways, deep cameo, midnight, teal, give it a richness suited to significant upholstery applications and generous wall installations. Part of the IMAGO collection .
